meta.siteDescription: Portfolio of Tushar Banswal, a Full-Stack Developer specializing in real-time systems, scalable web applications, and modern user experiences.

hero.name: Tushar Banswal
hero.bio: I engineer real-time, scalable web products — from pixel-perfect UIs to high-throughput backend systems.

about.statement: A developer who cares deeply about both code quality and real-time performance.
about.paragraph: With 2+ years shipping production-grade applications, I specialize in real-time telemetry systems, scalable backend APIs, and enterprise-grade full-stack frameworks — ensuring every product is fast, maintainable, and delightful to use.

projects.title: Real-Time Telemetry System
projects.description: Engineered low-latency, bidirectional data streaming using MQTT and WebSockets across critical medical equipment tracking modules — EndoScopes, Active Dashboard, Cycle Info.

projects.title: t-Lang — Custom Interpreted Language
projects.description: Designed and built an interpreted programming language from scratch — implementing a Lexer, AST generator, and execution engine with lexical scoping, control flow, and an interactive CLI REPL.

items.title: Full-Stack Web Development
items.description: End-to-end web applications built with React, Next.js, and Node.js — optimized for performance, scalability, and clean architecture.

items.title: Real-Time Systems
items.description: Low-latency, bidirectional data streaming using WebSockets, Socket.io, and MQTT for dashboards, IoT, and live collaboration tools.

items.title: API & Backend Engineering
items.description: Robust RESTful APIs, microservices, and MongoDB/MSSQL database architecture with secure enterprise authentication (OAuth, Entra ID, LDAP).

items.title: Test Automation & CI/CD
items.description: End-to-end automated testing with Playwright and TypeScript, integrated into Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines.

items.title: UI/UX Design & Component Libs
items.description: Clean, accessible interface design plus reusable component libraries (MUI, custom) that accelerate cross-team feature delivery.

items.title: Code Review & Consulting
items.description: Architecture review, MongoDB aggregation optimization, performance auditing, and hands-on consulting to reduce technical debt.
